description.value: A bed and breakfast located in Port Alberni in the heart of Vancouver Island, BC. The property operates as a small guesthouse with a Facebook presence showing recent activity and a small but engaged following. Port Alberni sits at the head of the Alberni Inlet and is a common stopping point for cyclists crossing Vancouver Island on routes such as Highway 4.
